about: Standard scenes. capture.py builds each in a new scene from its mel, saves it as <name>.ma, reopens that file and records world matrices and sample points at each frame. @REFERENCED@ is replaced with the path of the small file the reference scene references.

scenes.name: primitives_history
scenes.mel: polyCube -w 2 -h 3 -d 4 -sx 2; polySphere -r 1.5; move 4 0 0; polyCylinder; move 8 0 0; polyPlane -sx 3 -sy 3; move 12 0 0; polyCone; move 16 0 0; polyTorus; move 20 0 0; polyExtrudeFacet -ltz 1 pCube1.f[0]; polyBevel pSphere1.e[0]; circle; sphere; nurbsPlane;

scenes.name: keyed_tangents
scenes.mel: string $types[] = {"auto", "spline", "linear", "flat", "step", "stepnext", "clamped", "plateau", "fast", "slow"}; int $i = 0; for ($t in $types) { string $c[] = `polyCube -n ("key_" + $t)`; setKeyframe -t 1 -v 0 -itt $t -ott $t -at ty $c[0]; setKeyframe -t 12 -v 5 -itt $t -ott $t -at ty $c[0]; setKeyframe -t 24 -v 1 -itt $t -ott $t -at ty $c[0]; setAttr ($c[0] + ".tx") ($i * 2); $i++; }

scenes.name: skinned_arm
scenes.mel: polyCylinder -r 0.5 -h 6 -sx 8 -sy 12 -ax 1 0 0 -n arm; move 3 0 0; makeIdentity -a 1 -t 1 arm; select -cl; joint -p 0 0 0 -n shoulder; joint -p 3 0 0 -n elbow; joint -p 6 0 0 -n wrist; skinCluster -n armSkin shoulder arm; setKeyframe -t 1 -v 0 -at rz elbow; setKeyframe -t 24 -v 90 -at rz elbow; setKeyframe -t 1 -v 0 -at ry shoulder; setKeyframe -t 24 -v 45 -at ry shoulder;

scenes.name: constraints
scenes.mel: spaceLocator -n driver; setKeyframe -t 1 -v 0 -at tx driver; setKeyframe -t 24 -v 10 -at tx driver; setKeyframe -t 1 -v 0 -at ry driver; setKeyframe -t 24 -v 90 -at ry driver; spaceLocator -n aimUp; move 0 5 0 aimUp; polyCube -n cParent; move 0 2 0; parentConstraint -mo driver cParent; polyCube -n cPoint; move 0 4 0; pointConstraint -mo driver cPoint; polyCube -n cOrient; move 0 6 0; orientConstraint -mo driver cOrient; polyCube -n cScale; move 0 8 0; scaleConstraint driver cScale; polyCube -n cAim; move 0 10 5; aimConstraint -aim 1 0 0 -u 0 1 0 -wut object -wuo aimUp driver cAim; polyCube -n cPoleTarget; polyPlane -n cGeoPlane -w 20 -h 20; move 0 -2 0; polyCube -n cGeo; geometryConstraint cGeoPlane cGeo; normalConstraint cGeoPlane cGeo;

scenes.name: blendshape
scenes.mel: polySphere -n base; polySphere -n target; move -r 0 1 0 target.vtx[0:100]; move 5 0 0 target; blendShape -n bs target base; setKeyframe -t 1 -v 0 bs.target; setKeyframe -t 24 -v 1 bs.target;

scenes.name: lattice
scenes.mel: polySphere -n latBall; string $l[] = `lattice -dv 3 3 3 -oc 1 latBall`; rename $l[0] latFfd; rename $l[1] latCage; rename $l[2] latBase; setKeyframe -t 1 -v 0 -at ty "latCage.pt[1][2][1]"; select -r "latCage.pt[1][2][1]"; setKeyframe -t 1; move -r 0 1 0; setKeyframe -t 24;

scenes.name: display_layer
scenes.mel: polyCube -n inLayer; polyCube -n hiddenOne; createDisplayLayer -n layerA -e inLayer; createDisplayLayer -n layerB -e hiddenOne; setAttr layerB.visibility 0; setAttr layerA.color 13;

scenes.name: image_plane
scenes.mel: camera -n shotCam; imagePlane -c shotCam -fn "plate.png" -n plate; setAttr plateShape.alphaGain 0.5;

scenes.name: units_m_rad_pal
scenes.mel: currentUnit -l m -a rad -t pal; polyCube -n metres -w 2; move 1 2 3; rotate 0 1 0; setKeyframe -t 1 -at tx metres; setKeyframe -t 25 -v 4 -at tx metres; setKeyframe -t 1 -at ry metres; setKeyframe -t 25 -v 2 -at ry metres; polyCube -n conn; connectAttr metres.tx conn.rx;

scenes.name: hierarchy_pivots
scenes.mel: polyCube -n a; move 1 0 0; polyCube -n b; move 2 0 0; group -n g1 a b; polyCube -n c; parent c a; xform -ws -rp 5 5 5 a; xform -ws -sp 1 1 1 b; rotate 0 45 0 g1; instance -n aInst b; duplicate -n bDup b;
